title: Bot AI nuance + arena polish — finish GDP-2026-05-29-010 Layer 3, push visible cues + onboarding-grade touch-ups
notes: Closes the remaining slices of GDP-2026-05-29-010 Layer 3 (Coward decoy bomb, Miner feign-corner) on top of the S262 Hunter fake-flee. Then a polish wave: HUD telegraph for the personality-shift state (Layer 2 already wired, but no visible signal yet), audio + landing-pop for the S181/S182 step jump, and a chain-reaction cue distinct from the regular S243 bomb-place puff so bombers can read 'this was triggered by another bomb' at a glance.

Single sprint branch (`sprint/177-bot-ai-nuance`) — stories ship as atomic commits, single PR at sprint close. Each story keeps its own commit body + acceptance line so the QA terminal can match a verification line per slice.

Sprint size 10 (matches the post-2026-05-13 doubled default per feedback-sprint-size). Mix is ~5 gameplay-mechanic + ~5 polish so the bot-AI nuance work has a clear visible payoff in the same release window.
outOfScope: Outline-occluder shader (GDP-2026-05-28-014) — sketched in proposals but the shader pass is a meaty separate slice; lands in a future sprint
Engine billboard primitive (GDP-2026-05-27-008) — foundation work, deferred until a concrete consumer needs it
Wang 2-corner tiles / cliff-face Wang / per-biome geometry (GDP-2026-05-29-005..007, GDP-2026-05-30-003) — visual-heavy, separate sprint
Multi-bot in connected mode (GDP-2026-05-27-003) — networked, separate sprint
Multiplayer parity sweep (GDP-2026-05-27-010) — networked, separate sprint
Step-jump pathfinding cost adjustment (1.2× hop cost in GDP-2026-05-28-015) — the visible animation is what the user feels; tuning bot pathing for steps stays a stretch slice for after Player UX work

stories.title: Hunter fake-flee bluff (GDP-2026-05-29-010 Layer 3 hunter slice)
stories.summary: New bot-ai-bluff.ts module + BotBluffState component + integration into bot-ai-system. Hunter rolls 10% per brain tick when player is 4..10 cells away; phases are fleeing (1.5s) → approaching (until manhattan ≤ 3) → committing (forces PlaceBombRequest) → done. State drops on round-edge.
verification: acceptance: 21 unit tests cover every state transition + edge case; live Playwright probe sees BotBluffState mount on bot.1 hunter at +1.2s when player is teleported within range; no console errors; 2366/2366 vitest pass.

stories.title: Coward decoy-bomb bluff (GDP-2026-05-29-010 Layer 3 coward slice)
stories.summary: BotBluffState union widens to kind='decoy-bomb'. Phases placing-decoy → retreating (1.5s) → placing-real → done. bluffForcesBomb predicate centralises the bomb-commit edges (committing | placing-decoy | placing-real). bluffPreferredDirection adds the 'retreating' branch (vector away from player, mirrors 'fleeing'). Coward 15%/tick gate at the same 4..10 cell distance band as the hunter.
verification: acceptance: 11 new unit tests cover shouldStartCowardBluff probability + distance band, startCowardBluff mount, bluffForcesBomb predicate, advanceBluffState decoy phases (placing-decoy → retreating → placing-real → done), bluffPreferredDirection retreating; live Playwright probe sees bot.2 (coward) enter placing-decoy then retreating at +5.4s when player teleported into range; 2377/2377 vitest pass.

stories.title: Miner feign-corner bluff (GDP-2026-05-29-010 Layer 3 miner slice)
stories.summary: BotBluffKind widens to 'feign-corner'. Phases feigning (1.5s, dir={0,0}) → slipping (1.5s, dir=away) → done. Most subtle of the three bluffs — no bomb commit, pure psychological misdirection. Also fixes a dt-unit bug that was applying to all bluff kinds: the bluff advance lived inside the brain-tick cooldown gate, so passing fixedDt (1/60s) made elapsed accumulate ~12× too slowly. Switched to DECISION_INTERVAL (0.2s) so wall-clock durations match the GDP's intended timings.
verification: acceptance: 9 new unit tests cover shouldStartMinerBluff probability + distance band, startMinerBluff mount, feign-corner state machine transitions (feigning → slipping → done), bluffPreferredDirection (feigning returns {0,0}, slipping returns vector-away), bluffForcesBomb returns false for both feign-corner phases; live Playwright probe sees bot.3 (miner) walk feigning → slipping → done within 4.2s real time after player teleport into range; 2386/2386 vitest pass; no console errors.

stories.title: HUD tag shows active bluff per bot
stories.summary: api.status() now surfaces BotBluffState per bomber (filtered to phase != done); the kaboom.stats HUD widget appends a compact tag to each bot line — '[bait]' for fake-flee, '[decoy]' for decoy-bomb, '[feint]' for feign-corner. Lets the player read the bluff in flight without digging into devtools.
verification: acceptance: live Playwright probe mounts BotBluffState on bot.1/bot.2/bot.3 (one of each kind) and reads the rendered HUD DOM — bot.2 line is 'bot.2 [decoy]   bombs 0/1   fire 2'; bot.3 is 'bot.3 [feint]   bombs 0/1   fire 2'; bot.1 advanced to done and shows no tag (filter intact). npm run typecheck clean. npx vitest run — 2386/2386 pass.

stories.title: HUD telegraph for L2 personality shifts (per GDP-2026-05-29-010 — Reckless / Patient / Brave Coward etc.)
stories.summary: Renders the tally bias from S227 (already adjusts aggression internally) as a visible icon ('🔥' reckless, '🛡' patient, etc.) next to each bot's tally entry. Reads RoundState.tally + bot personality at HUD-build time.

stories.title: Step-jump audio — whoosh on launch + thud on landing
stories.summary: Adds short audio cues at the takeoff + landing windows of the S181/S182 step-jump arc. Total audio ~150 ms; hooks the existing audio system. URL `?stepJumpAudio=off` disables.

stories.title: Step-jump landing pop — brief Transform.scale impulse on landing (in addition to the S182 squash arc)
stories.summary: On the LANDING edge (currentLerp crosses from <1 to 1 across a delta=1 cell tween), apply a 1-frame Y-squash to the bomber mesh that decays over 120ms. Reads as a 'real thud' beyond the squash arc, which is symmetric around the jump.

stories.title: Distinct puff tint when a bomb is chain-triggered (vs its own fuse)
stories.summary: When chainBombsAt forces fuseRemaining to 0 (bomb-fuse-system), tag the chained bomb so the next-tick blast spawn carries a CHAIN-tint emitter — e.g. `glow` cyan to differentiate from the regular orange spark blast. Reads as 'I caught your other bomb in the chain' at a glance.

stories.title: Bomb fuse critical-pulse — red flash on the bomb cell at fuse < 0.4s
stories.summary: Adds a one-shot red puff (spawnPuff with `color: "#ff3030"`, lifetime 0.15s) at the bomb cell the first tick the bomb crosses fuse < 0.4s. Telegraphs 'about to detonate' beyond the existing wiggle + colour pulse, which can be hard to read in chaotic moments.

stories.title: Subtle accent on the bomber mesh while a bluff is active
stories.summary: Brief MeshRenderer.color shift on the hunter / coward / miner during their bluff phase. Picks up the bomber's palette accent so the bot LOOKS 'switched on' (visually distinct from baseline cruising). Cosmetic, not gameplay.

stories.title: Sprint S177 close — archive proposals + render backlog views
stories.summary: Mark S177 archived, set archivedAt + prUrl, archive any proposal files closed by the sprint slices (e.g. GDP-2026-05-29-010 once all three bluff types ship), and re-run backlog:render so BACKLOG.md / BACKLOG_ARCHIVE.md regenerate from the JSON.
